globalElevation.encoding: gzip + signed int16 little-endian meters; value is rounded arithmetic mean of valid 5x5 NOAA one-minute cells.
globalElevation.resolutionLimit: Illustrative global sea-level threshold layer; 5 arc-minute aggregation is not a hydrological reconstruction and does not model barriers, drainage, tides, or local datum differences.

AFRICA.method: area-weighted spherical centroid of owned cells, including interior water

ANTARCTICA.method: area-weighted spherical centroid of owned cells, including interior water

S_AMERICA.method: area-weighted spherical centroid of owned cells, including interior water

landmassIds.encoding: gzip + unsigned byte IDs; 0 ocean/unknown, 1-6 per idLegend.
landmassIds.ownershipSemantics: Landmass ownership for transformations, not a dry-land mask. Interior lake pixels receive their surrounding/nearest landmass; height data determines elevation and water level. IDs do not represent political borders or tectonic plates.
landmassIds.sourceDataUsedOnlyForGeneration: Natural Earth Admin 0 CONTINENT attribute plus lake polygon geometry; no country-level features or attributes are shipped.

saharaElevation.encoding: gzip + signed int16 little-endian meters; NOAA one-minute values rounded to nearest meter.
saharaElevation.resolutionLimit: Coarse global-relief source; contours are illustrative, not a basin hydrology or lake reconstruction.

encoding: Gzip-compressed C-order binary; int16 is signed little-endian, u8 is unsigned; gzip header mtime is fixed to zero.
gridConvention: WGS84 longitude/latitude, pixel centers, row-major north-to-south, columns west-to-east, longitude wraps at +/-180 degrees.

etopo2022.citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022. ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model. https://doi.org/10.25921/fd45-gt74 (60 arc-second supplied global extract).
etopo2022.title: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, ETOPO 2022 60 Arc-Second Global Relief Model, ice-surface elevation

verticalReference: Meters relative to EGM2008 geoid (EPSG:3855); EGM2008 is an approximate mean-sea-level reference, and some shallow-water source areas may use different vertical datums.
